text:
maya: quick sync — propose a `v2` route bisect + fallback playbook. need to lock the migration primitives (headers, error thresholds, and escape hatches) before we announce to customers

sam: +1. what's the plan for opt-in? header vs param?

maya: leaning header to avoid URL churn: `X-Redwood-API-Version: v2` for opt-in. default stays v1 until rollout finishes.

leo: major concern: tool/function-calling behavior changes break older SDKs. we should provide a runtime-level compatibility mode that can be toggled per-request. escape hatch = `X-Redwood-Compat: v1`

anika: fyi CS has 3 enterprise customers asking to stall changes to rerank/embeddings for ~6 months. they rely on v1 rerank logits.

maya: understood — propose phased rollout: 1) document contract differences (quick diff table) 2) add opt-in header 3) canary at 5% then 30% if metrics look good 4) full switch with automated fallback to v1 when error rate or correctness regressions detected

sam: for canary routing we can do header->route mapping in ingress. example nginx snippet:```
map $http_x_redwood_api_version $target {
    default v1;
    ~^v2 v2;
}
proxy_pass http://upstream_$target;
```

leo: runtime fallback idea: if v2 returns 5xx or quality-check fails (eval harness) within 15s, automatically proxy same request to v1 and emit metric `compat.fallback.count`

anika: customers want visibility — add a response header when fallback happens: `X-Redwood-Fallback: v1` so CS can audit.

maya: launch acceptance gates (must pass before 100%):
- perf: p50 and p95 within 10% of v1 for same model config
- errors: end-to-end error rate delta < 0.25%
- quality: no regression on customer-critical evals (blocked prompts)

sam: SDK impact: we need to ship minor SDK patch that preserves old method signatures and sets `X-Redwood-Compat: v1` by default for semver minor. also docs/example for `X-Redwood-API-Version: v2` usage.

leo: ops tasks: implement runtime proxy fallback, emit metrics and tracing, add `compat` feature flag to console so customers can toggle per-route

maya: action items: maya -> write migration guide + diff table (due EOD next Tue), sam -> SDK patch + tests (due next Fri), leo -> runtime fallback PR + metrics (due next Wed), anika -> compile customer ask list and cutover windows (ongoing)

deploy-bot: rollout flag `v2_optin_header` created in staging. :white_check_mark:

maya: ok — plan looks good. we'll present this at the roadmap review tomorrow. please react with :+1: if you agree or comment if any unblockers.
